_note: Agent verdicts on the pairs proposed by scripts/library-find-duplicates.py. The detector CANNOT decide these on its own: measured over this library, same-work pairs score 0.248-1.000 on char-gram Jaccard and known-different pairs (a paper and its sequel; a same-author series reusing its setup sections) score 0.159-0.435. Those ranges OVERLAP, so no threshold separates them and every pair needs a reading. scripts/library-resolve-duplicates.py acts only on verdict 'same-work'; anything 'needs-agent' is left alone.

_verdicts.same-work: one work, held more than once (preprint/published, two ingests of one file, arXiv version bump)
_verdicts.different-work: genuinely distinct papers that share text - usually a sequel or a same-author series
_verdicts.needs-agent: proposed by the detector, not yet read

adjudicated.why: Neumann-Zagier, Volumes of hyperbolic three-manifolds (Topology 24, 1985), held three times: the Elsevier PDF and two re-ingests of the same scan.

Garoufalidis-Zagier, 'Hyperbolic 3-manifolds, the Bloch group and the work of Walter Neumann'. Two ingests of the arXiv PDF plus the Celebratio Mathematica version (27pp vs 19pp - same text, different house style).
Milnor, 'Hyperbolic geometry: the first 150 years' (Bull. AMS 6, 1982). Identical extracted text.
Zagier, 'The Dilogarithm Function' (MPI). The directory name records the second as a copy.
Braden-Northover, "Bring's curve: its period matrix and the vector of Riemann constants", SIGMA 8 (2012) 065 - arXiv preprint and the SIGMA published version, same DOI.
Lovejoy-Osburn, 'The colored Jones polynomial and Kontsevich-Zagier series for double twist knots'. Same 24pp.
Garoufalidis-Hodgson-Rubinstein-Segerman, '1-efficient triangulations and the index of a cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold'. Same 60pp.
Garoufalidis-Kashaev, 'From state integrals to q-series'. Same 16pp.
Birman-Wrinkle/Menasco, 'Stabilization in the braid groups II'. arXiv v4 and the Geometry & Topology published version, same 28pp.
Garoufalidis-Wheeler, 'Modular q-holonomic modules'. 65pp vs 66pp - same text, one carries an extra page.
Masbaum, 'Skein-theoretical derivation of some formulas of Habiro'. arXiv and AGT published version, same 20pp, both dated 16 June 2003.

DeTurck-Gluck-Komendarczyk-Melvin-Shonkwiler, 'Triple linking numbers, ambiguous Hopf invariants and integral formulas for three-component links'. arXiv 23pp and the Bol. Soc. Bras. Mat. version 33pp.
Braden-Disney-Hogg, "Bring's curve: old and new". arXiv 38pp and the European J. Math published version 46pp.
Garoufalidis-Yoon, 'Twisted Neumann-Zagier matrices'. arXiv and the Res. Math. Sci. published version, both 23pp.
Baseilhac-Benedetti, 'Quantum hyperbolic geometry'. arXiv math/0611504 40pp and the AGT 7 (2007) 845-917 published version 73pp - the published version is longer, which is why the score is mid-band.

Komendarczyk, arXiv:0808.1533 - same identifier, v1 and v3. Retitled between versions ('On the third order helicity of magnetic fields on invariant domains in S3' -> '...via link maps'), which is why the heads diverge; one arXiv id is one work.
Lee, 'Groebner-Shirshov bases for Temperley-Lieb algebras of types B and D'. arXiv 9pp and the Palestine J. Math. 7 (Special Issue I, 2018) 11-17 published version 7pp.

Ohtsuki, 'On the asymptotic expansion of the Kashaev invariant of the 5_2 knot'. Preprint 52pp and the Quantum Topology 7 (2016) 669-735 published version 67pp. Low score is the length difference, not a doubt.

Riera-Rodriguez, "The period matrix of Bring's curve", Pacific J. Math. 154 (1992) 1. The second copy extracted only 2 sections of 22pp against the first's 8 of 25pp, so it agrees on less text - the shortfall is extraction quality, not identity.

Both Morita on the Ramanujan q-difference equation, but distinct papers: 'On local solutions of the Ramanujan equation and their connection formulae' vs 'The Stokes phenomenon for the Ramanujan's q-difference equation and its higher order extension'. Shared setup sections, different results. This is the highest-scoring different-work pair and the reason no threshold can be trusted alone.
Both Lei Yang: 'Modular curves, invariant theory and E8' (39pp) vs 'E8-singularity, invariant theory and modular forms' (48pp). Heavily overlapping exposition, distinct papers.
Morita: 'A connection formula between the Ramanujan function and the q-Airy function' (12pp) vs 'On local solutions of the Ramanujan equation' (19pp).
Morita, two further distinct papers in the same series.
'The strong AJ conjecture for cables of torus knots' (Tran) vs 'The strong AJ conjecture for the figure eight knot' (Nguyen-Tran). Same conjecture, different knots, shared preliminaries.
'Groebner-Shirshov bases for Temperley-Lieb algebras of types B and D' vs 'Groebner-Shirshov bases for non-crystallographic Coxeter groups'. Same authors and method, different objects.
